subject: Lodestar visual/UX overhaul — kill "underwhelming", premium feel
description: Operator: "the piping might be great but from the UX/UI I cannot tell — from the visual aspect it is underwhelming." Headline of the Lodestar marathon. Fable-led (design-strong model). Elevate whole app: deliberate palette extending existing Lodestar brand + fal.ai logo (preserve IMP-10/IMP-12), real type hierarchy, spacing, component states, confident dashboard first screen. Not a reskin. QC: Nancy + Chris + my own rendered smoke-check before it's called done. No commit/deploy without QC.
